items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Ed Moishier. I'm talking about the way back you know.

ctx.x: How was his playing, can you remember that?

Well he was a good piano player and a good singer too. Oh the same. Yeah, he was a good singer and a good piano player. Really good. Oh and there was so many of those guys around there. And Calvin Jackson and he was a piano player. Ed Moishier. I'm talking about the way back you know. And all them was fellas that hanged around the district you know what I mean. Couldn't play piano you know what I mean.
It's interesting that you hear those names. Remember Alfred Wilson?
